Killeen, TX 76549
$245,900, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,708 SF, MLS# 609786

Welcome to this meticulously maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bath gem, perfectly situated in a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from everything! Spanning 1,708 sq ft of comfortable living space, this 2006-built home offers a functional layout ideal for modern living. Enjoy a private, fully fenced backyard, your own peaceful oasis for weekend BBQs or pets. Location is unbeatable: walk or drive in minutes to Texas A&M University, community college, schools, and local dining. With groceries, pharmacies, and the military base nearby, your daily errands are a breeze. Plus, immediate access to major roads makes your commute to the big cities effortless. Imagine the luxury of running daily errands in minutes, then returning to this welcoming living space. You can picture your family gathering in the open-concept kitchen, or hosting summer barbecues in the fully fenced backyard. The primary suite offers a quiet retreat at the end of the day, while the remaining bedrooms are perfect for a growing family or a dedicated home office. This is the move-in-ready home you've been waiting for, Come see it before it’s gone!

2 full bath
